name: One Piece
description: One Piece is a story about a young pirate, Monkey D. Luffy, on his quest to find the legendary treasure, One Piece, and become the Pirate King.

name: Naruto
description: Naruto follows the story of Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja who seeks to become the strongest and gain the respect of his village while dealing with the burden of the Nine-Tails Fox inside him.

name: Attack on Titan
description: Centuries ago, humanity was forced to live within massive walls to protect themselves from the terrifying Titans. Eren Yeager, motivated by revenge, joins the Survey Corps to fight these giant humanoid creatures.

name: Dragon Ball Z
description: Dragon Ball Z follows the adventures of Goku as he defends Earth from various powerful foes, such as Freeza, Cell, and Majin Buu.

name: Bleach
description: Bleach follows Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenager who gains the powers of a Soul Reaper and must protect the living from evil spirits while fighting enemies from the Spirit World.

name: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: Jujutsu Kaisen follows Yuji Itadori as he becomes involved in the world of curses after ingesting a powerful cursed object and gaining abilities to fight dangerous curses.

name: My Hero Academia
japanese: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
description: In a world where nearly everyone has superpowers known as Quirks, Izuku Midoriya, born without one, strives to become the greatest hero.

name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: Two brothers, Edward and Alphonse Elric, use alchemy to search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies after a failed alchemical experiment.

name: Demon Slayer
description: Demon Slayer follows Tanjiro Kamado, a young boy who becomes a demon slayer to avenge his family and cure his sister, who was turned into a demon.

name: Tokyo Ghoul
description: Tokyo Ghoul follows Ken Kaneki, a college student who becomes a half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter, and his struggles to live in the world of humans and ghouls.

name: Death Note
description: Death Note is about Light Yagami, a high school student who discovers a notebook that allows him to kill anyone whose name he writes in it.

name: Sword Art Online
japanese: ソードアート・オンライン
description: Sword Art Online follows Kirito, a player trapped in a virtual reality MMORPG, as he must fight to escape and protect his friends within the game.
